sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with five straight wins and a draw in their last six outings. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from a recent draw and maintain pressure on the leaders—Stafford's 20 points keep them just two behind Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points, host Eccleshall in a clash between two of the division's stronger sides, while Wolverhampton Casuals (also 19 points) travel to face Wednesfield Community. In-form Bilston Town, fifth with 17 points and two wins in their last three, take on Foley Meir at home. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a mid-table affair, Shawbury United face Barnton in another mid-table encounter, Crewe host Allscott Heath at home, Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement clash between sides struggling for points, and Brereton Social host Widnes Town—the latter pointless at the bottom with just 2 points from 7 games.
